title: Datacube Extension
description: STAC Datacube Extension for STAC Items and STAC Collections.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Items.

anyOf.$comment: This validates the fields in Item Assets.

oneOf.$comment: This is the schema for STAC Collections.

anyOf.$comment: This is the schema for the top-level fields in a Collection.
This validates the fields in Collection Assets.
This is the schema for the fields in Item Asset Definitions.
This is the schema for the fields in Summaries. By default, only checks the existance of the properties, but not the schema of the summaries.

require_any_field.$comment: Please list all fields here so that we can force the existance of one of them in other parts of the schemas.

fields.$comment: Add your new fields here. Don't require them here, do that above in the corresponding schema.

cube:dimensions.title: Dimensions
cube:dimensions.description: Uniquely named dimensions of the datacube.

cube:variables.title: Variables
cube:variables.description: Uniquely named variables of the datacube.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to explain the dimension. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

step.title: Step
step.description: If the dimension consists of interval values, the space between the values. Use `null` for irregularly spaced steps.

reference_system.title: Reference System
reference_system.description: The reference system for the data and datacube metadata (`extent`, `values` and `step`).

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: Names of dimensions (keys in `cube:dimensions`). The schema allows this field on additional dimensions, but the extension README documents it only for variables.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to explain the dimension. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

step.title: Step
step.description: The space between the values. Use `null` for irregularly spaced steps.

reference_system.title: Reference System
reference_system.description: The spatial reference system for the data and datacube metadata (`extent`, `values` and `step`), specified as numerical EPSG code, WKT2 (ISO 19162) string or PROJJSON object. Defaults to EPSG code 4326.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to explain the dimension. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

step.title: Step
step.description: If the dimension consists of interval values, the space between the values. Use `null` for irregularly spaced steps.

reference_system.title: Reference System
reference_system.description: The spatial reference system for the data and datacube metadata (`extent`, `values` and `step`), specified as numerical EPSG code, WKT2 (ISO 19162) string or PROJJSON object. Defaults to EPSG code 4326.

axes.title: Axes
axes.description: Axes of the vector dimension as an ordered set of `x`, `y` and `z`. Defaults to `x` and `y`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to explain the dimension. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

bbox.title: Spatial extent
bbox.description: A single bounding box of the geometries as defined for STAC Collections, but not nested.

values.title: Values
values.description: Optionally, a representation of the geometries. This could be a list of WKT strings or other identifiers.

geometry_types.title: Geometry Types
geometry_types.description: A set of geometry types. If not present, mixed geometry types must be assumed.

reference_system.title: Reference System
reference_system.description: The spatial reference system for the data and datacube metadata (`bbox` and `values`), specified as numerical EPSG code, WKT2 (ISO 19162) string or PROJJSON object. Defaults to EPSG code 4326.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to explain the dimension. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

values.title: Values
values.description: If the dimension consists of an ordered list of specific values they can be listed here. The dates and/or times must be strings compliant to ISO 8601.

extent.title: Extent
extent.description: Extent (lower and upper bounds) of the dimension as two-element array. The dates and/or times must be strings compliant to ISO 8601. `null` is allowed for open date ranges.

step.title: Step
step.description: The space between the temporal instances as ISO 8601 duration, e.g. `P1D`. Use `null` for irregularly spaced steps.

oneOf.title: Data
oneOf.description: A variable indicating some measured value, for example "precipitation" or "temperature".

oneOf.title: Auxiliary
oneOf.description: A variable that contains coordinate data, but is not a dimension in `cube:dimensions`.

variable_type.title: Variable Type
variable_type.description: Type of the variable, either `data` or `auxiliary`. The extension README calls this field `type`, but the schema validates `variable_type`.

description.title: Description
description.description: Detailed multi-line description to explain the variable. CommonMark 0.29 syntax MAY be used for rich text representation.

dimensions.title: Dimensions
dimensions.description: The dimensions of the variable. This should refer to keys in the `cube:dimensions` object or be an empty list if the variable has no dimensions.

values.title: Values
values.description: An (ordered) list of all values, especially useful for nominal values.

extent.title: Extent
extent.description: If the variable consists of ordinal values, the extent (lower and upper bounds) of the values as two-element array. Use `null` for open intervals.

axis_xy.title: Axis
axis_xy.description: Axis of the spatial raster dimension (`x`, `y`).

axis_z.title: Axis
axis_z.description: Axis of the spatial dimension, always `z`.

extent_closed.title: Extent
extent_closed.description: Extent (lower and upper bounds) of the dimension as two-element array. Open intervals with `null` are not allowed.

extent_open.title: Extent
extent_open.description: If the dimension consists of ordinal values, the extent (lower and upper bounds) of the values as two-element array. Use `null` for open intervals.

values_numeric.title: Values
values_numeric.description: Optionally, an ordered list of all values.

values.title: Values
values.description: An ordered list of all values, especially useful for nominal values.

unit.$comment: The schema is from common metadata, see https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/v1.1.0/item-spec/json-schema/data-values.json
unit.title: Unit of Values
unit.description: The unit of measurement for the data, preferably compliant to UDUNITS-2 (unit symbol or singular unit name) or UCUM.

data_type.$comment: The schema is from common metadata, see https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/v1.1.0/item-spec/json-schema/data-values.json
data_type.title: Data Type of Values
data_type.description: The data type of the values in the datacube.

nodata.$comment: The schema is from common metadata, see https://github.com/radiantearth/stac-spec/blob/v1.1.0/item-spec/json-schema/data-values.json
nodata.title: No-Data Values
